Now There Are Real Friends, Like Brad Pitt,
Wearing A T-shirt That Reads, "I live for hemp." – Late Gossip

From MSNBC
http://www.msnbc.com/news/251820.asp

March 30, 1999

Brad Pitt for marijuana - Cannabis Pitt

Brad Pitt seems to be replacing Woody Harrelson as the celebrity defender of marijuana. The star of "Meet Joe Black" was recently spotted at a party for the United Talent Agency wearing a T-shirt emblazoned with a large cannabis leaf. Not long before that, he was seen at trendy Los Angeles restaurant Les Deux, in a T-shirt that read: "I live for hemp."

(Marijuananews note: More celebrities need to "come out of the closet" and voice their support for cannabis hemp. Kudos to Brad Pitt for wearing his support on his sleave, so to speak. Fortunately, Woody is not being replaced by Brad Pitt. He is merely being joined in the fray by one of Hollywood’s brightest new stars. How long before Letterman starts making Brad "Pot" jokes? -- John Dvorak)

John researches and writes about the past, present and future uses of cannabis hemp. He is the founder and proprietor of the Boston Hemp Co-op, Museum and Library. John was the Managing Editor of Hemp Magazine and has had articles published in Hempworld Magazine, the Journal of the International Hemp Association and Cannabis Canada (now Cannabis Culture). He is a member of the Hemp Industries Association, the International Hemp Association, and Mass Cann/NORML. He can be reached at boston.hemp@pobox.com and 781-662-4313.
